rows.grounds: indefinite pronoun referring to certain recipients; sandhi form of keṣām + cit
restrictive particle emphasizing limitation to some
past participle indicating completed transmission; referent understood from context

items.question: By what mode is transmission conveyed sequentially to certain recipients only?
premises: Transmission is restricted to certain recipients only.
The transmission passes from one mouth to another mouth.
This passing proceeds in a sequential order.
items.inference: Therefore, for some recipients the teaching is transmitted orally in due sequence.
uncertainties: The feminine referent of saṅkrāntā is not explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: For some indeed, it has been transmitted from mouth to mouth in due sequence.
